QuestInfo.name: Destroyer of Time
QuestInfo.1: Find the door that connects to another space in the Forgotten Passage, and defeat the culprit who destroyed the Clocktower. Report back to Neinheart when you've succeeded.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated Thanatos and reported to Neinheart.

0.0: Did you see all those weird doors floating in the Forgotten Passage? You didn't check out any of them, did you? Well, you should've!
0.1: My hunch was right, Thanatos was the one that tampered with the Clocktower! But why would he do that unless he was being controlled? Hm? Well, that's because that suspicious guy I saw was controlling Thanatos! There weren't any Mystic Gates in the area, so he had to have been the one! And I can guarantee you he's one of the Black Mage's followers!
0.2: Now that we know he was involved, we can't let him get away!

yes.0: One of the doors in the Forgotten Passage leads to culprit behind the problems at the Clocktower!
yes.1: Find that door and you've got our bad guy! If you can take him out, go back to Neinheart. I've got to make sure nothing else goes out of place. Hurry it up, okay?

no.0: What?! You're not going to do anything? But we have our culprit!

yes.0: I see. One of the Black Mage's underlings destroyed the Ludibrium Clocktower? Interesting. I will see that you are taken care of.

npc.0: Find the door that leads to the culprit in the Forgotten Passage and report back to Neinheart once you subdue him.

item.0: Do you have anything to tell me?

mob.0: Who is the mastermind behind the destruction of the Clocktower?
